It emphasizes transparency, accountability, and cooperation to make sure AI benefits everyone while reducing potential harms.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is an agreement that brings together governments, industry, and civil society to establish shared principles and standards for the safe, fair, and responsible development and deployment of artificial intelligence. It outlines commitments to transparency, accountability, and cooperation to promote innovation while mitigating risks and protecting human rights.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: The document lists specific AI practices that are prohibited, covering areas such as manipulation, privacy violations, and unsafe or deceptive use of artificial intelligence.
